purpose: Bounded gate-B replay of normalization and raw-noise mechanisms with current code; reused data, no model selection

normalization.procedure: Refit current RLE using frozen selected identities; reproduce saved factors. Recompute all observed unsigned W1 statistics and all 3999 permutation exceedance counts with current W1State, stopping disabled. Reproduce original p/q and 128-gene BH families. Measure factor error, contamination of selected controls, FDP and sensitivity with explicit denominators.
normalization.limits: Two reused cohorts per setting, not FDR certification. Genes used for normalization and testing are disjoint. The selector is not retrained. LOESS/log-GCV are the historical Python implementations; this does not validate or reproduce the user's complete biological panel-discovery workflow. Known exposures and known-initialization selections are mechanism controls only.

noise.procedure: Regenerate the original frozen perturbation draws from counts and recorded seeds. Verify every linear/log observed upward area against saved values. Evaluate current linear-up point_scores on the first 255 original label assignments, averaging statistics across the four draws (one for none), never averaging p-values. Keep the same feature eligibility mask and original known exposures.
noise.null: Nominal gene-level p<=0.05 with inclusive ties and fixed budget, no sequential stopping or BH claim. Preserve original full-budget BH counts as explicitly historical context only.
noise.denominator: This is a replay of the old fixed-exposure recipe, not an endorsement of adding counts without updating a library total. The count panels do not contain the full transcriptome; RLE is not fit to them. A coherent complete-library perturbation needs its own measurement model.
noise.limits: Two reused matrices per setting, no precise calibration claim. Unequal-depth cases are boundary diagnostics. Raw-added and common-analysis-unit noise are distinct interventions.

legacy: The retired fitted-bulk subset test is absent from every replay. Its earlier residual-fit failures do not establish a failure of these current point statistics.
decision: Attribute failures to normalization, perturbation units or conditional precision before changing an abundance kernel. Preserve unfavorable results. No production behavior changes.
